ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ] || { [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "master" ]; }; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
buildCommand: node -e "const e=process.env;if(e.VERCEL_ENV!=='preview'&&!(e.VERCEL_ENV==='production'&&e.VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF==='master')){console.error('Publicacao permitida somente em previa ou na branch master de producao.');process.exit(1)}" && npm run build
